response.text:
I can do that, but canceling a calendar series is a destructive, externally visible action and I need a few confirmations before proceeding — and I can’t watch for the SOW to be signed in the background. Please answer the brief questions below, or confirm the single-line option at the end.

Required details / confirmations
- Do you want to cancel the entire Friday Standup recurring series or only one upcoming occurrence? (I recommend canceling the series.)
- Exact event name and which calendar it’s on (e.g., “Friday Standup” on your default work calendar or “Engineering Team Calendar”).
- Should I send a cancellation (notifies attendees) or delete it silently (no notifications)? (Cancellation is standard so attendees get the update.)
- Timezone to use for the event if relevant.
- Is the SOW already signed now so you want me to act immediately, or do you want me to wait for you to confirm later? (I cannot monitor or act automatically when the SOW signs unless you trigger the action.)
- Who should be the sender of the cancellation/notification? (You, the team lead, or me on your behalf via the calendar tool.)

Draft notification (edit or approve)
"Hi team — The recurring Friday standup is canceled effective immediately. Please remove it from your calendars. We’ll share any alternative sync plans as needed. If you need a 1:1 or a different recurring time, let me know."

If that’s fine, reply with:
- The answers to the questions above, and
- "Cancel series now" (explicit confirmation).

If you prefer, say “Just draft the message” and I’ll provide alternate tones (short/casual or formal) without touching the calendar.
